note.overview: Recall sum possum and eo in five tenses, including accepted eo perfect-stem variants.
learningGoals: Produce sum possum and eo in five tenses.
Accept and recognise both forms represented by the school's i(v) notation.
mustMemoriseRules: possum changes between poss and pot before different forms of sum.
eo future uses ibo ibis ibit; imperfect uses ibam ibas ibat.
For eo perfect and pluperfect, both forms represented by i(v) are accepted.
